newsitem.title: USA: McDonald Happy Meals include beanbag toy - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: McDonald Happy Meals include beanbag toy - WSJ.

text.p: McDonald's Corp will on Friday start giving away tiny versions of the popular beanbag toy Beanie Babies with the purchase of its children's Happy Meal, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition.

Plans call for participating restaurants to offer two Teenie Beanie Babies a week through May 15, making 10 toys in all, the Journal said. The promotion was not advertised in advance, it said. The newspaper said McDonald's was expecting some stores to run out of toys of the week.
Beanie Babies were made by Oak Brook, Ill.-based Ty Inc.
